findings.finding: _valid_workflow only checks that a queued filename exists in .github/workflows; tick() then executes gh workflow run with queue-supplied inputs. No strict workflow allowlist.
findings.impact: Any existing workflow, including privileged workflows, can be dispatched by a queue entry.

findings.finding: Current main grants contents:write and actions:write and runs the mutating scheduler tick.
Manual dispatch defaults dry_run=false; max_prs=0 means unlimited; mode=all is available; GH_PAT write/merge capability; no explicit per-PR designated-human approval check found in inspected source.
findings.impact: Can update branches and attempt merges; exposed branch metadata shows no required status contexts.
